title: Provenance and local source state
description: How this documentation slice records where each page came from.
text:
Provenance

Generated records expose the effective source repository label, relative path, local ref, and SHA-256 content hash. A hash is evidence about these bytes; it is not presented as a Git commit SHA.

 Historical pages

Historical fixture pages use a separate immutable version identifier and never follow the working tree.

title: Governance
description: The documented boundaries for reviewing and publishing Paper & Slate documentation.
text:
Governance

Paper & Slate publishes documentation from a local, reviewable source set. This page records the boundaries that are
currently evidenced by the documentation system; it is not a claim of institutional approval or production status.

 Source review

Central pages are reviewed repository-owned Markdown. Each ingested page retains its source path, local ref, and
content hash. Fixture, sibling-local, and future Git-imported pages remain separated from the reviewed central rendering
path.

 Versions and provenance

Supported and historical versions remain independent records. A content hash identifies the recorded bytes; it is not
presented as a Git commit SHA. Raw Markdown routes remain available for source inspection.

 Honest status

Local checks can establish source shape, route behavior, rendering boundaries, and generated artifacts. They do not by
themselves establish deployment, legal review, provider activation, production monitoring, or factual approval.

title: Course and Catalog Schema
text:
Course and Catalog Schema

Status: Planned. A course record could describe title, summary, audience, prerequisites, and catalog relationships. It must not imply enrollment, credit, accreditation, or completion without separately verified facts.

title: Curriculum Standards Schema
text:
Curriculum Standards Schema

Status: Experimental. A future record may link learning materials to an identified framework, jurisdiction, or version. Alignment is a review claim and must remain explicit; no official conformance is asserted here.

title: .well-known Education Discovery
text:
.well-known Education Discovery

Status: Experimental. A future discovery document could identify education resources, ownership, and documentation routes. This local proposal does not publish a network endpoint or assert ecosystem support.

 Safety boundary

Consumers should treat discovery as descriptive metadata and verify source provenance before relying on it.

title: File System
text:
File System

Status: Planned. This proposal describes a stable place for educational files and their review metadata. It has no normative adoption.

 Ownership

Each document should retain its source path, version, edit date, and local content hash. Publication is a generated local artifact, not a request-time import.

title: Organization Schema
text:
Organization Schema

Status: Planned. A possible organization record may include a display name, public URL, contact route, and provenance. Legal identity, registration, affiliation, and endorsement remain unverified facts.

title: Tools and Libraries
text:
Tools and Libraries

Status: Planned. An inventory entry may record a name, purpose, version, license reference, and review date. It should distinguish descriptive listing from endorsement and retain source provenance.
